meta.title: ABLE — Work that fits you
meta.description: ABLE connects job seekers with disabilities to employers who want to hire them — with profiles that show real skills, AI matching, and built-in chat, voice and video calls.

notice.missingKeys: Some services aren’t configured in this environment: {services}. Related features show a short explanation instead.

verified.emailDetail: This person confirmed they own their email address.
verified.orgDetail: ABLE checked this organization’s registration number with official records.
verified.identityDetail: Government ID check. Coming next — ABLE doesn’t collect ID numbers yet.

home.headline: Work that fits you.
home.subline: Show what you can do. Get found by employers who want to hire you.

styleguide.title: ABLE design system
styleguide.intro: Tokens and components used across ABLE.
styleguide.dialogBody: Dialogs drop in from above and trap focus until closed.
styleguide.sheetBody: Sheets slide up from the bottom. Drag the handle down to close.
styleguide.nameHint: Use the name employers will see.
styleguide.bioPlaceholder: A few sentences about what you do best
styleguide.skillsPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter
styleguide.switchLabel: Show my age on my profile
styleguide.tabAText: Posts content slides in from the side of the selected tab.
styleguide.faqQ: Do I have to say I have a disability?
styleguide.faqA: No. Anything about your work setup is optional and private unless you choose to share it.
styleguide.typeBody: Body text sits at 16px with a 1.6 line height and never runs longer than 72 characters, so long reading stays comfortable on every screen.
styleguide.emptyBody: Star people from your feed and they’ll appear here.

explore.title: Explore talent
explore.subtitle: Browse people by skill, location and how they like to work.
explore.emptyBody: Profiles appear here as soon as talent publish them.

auth.title: Welcome to ABLE
auth.subtitle: Sign in or create an account
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn’t set up in this environment. Use email instead.
auth.otpInvalid: That code isn’t right. Check it and try again.
auth.otpInvalidLeft: That code isn’t right. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
auth.otpExpired: That code has expired. We can send you a new one.
auth.otpTooMany: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in needs a database, which isn’t set up in this environment. Try Judge mode to explore with sample data.
auth.terms: By continuing, you agree to ABLE’s <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

welcome.title: How will you use ABLE?
welcome.subtitle: Choose one to start. You can add the other later in Settings.
welcome.talentBody: Build a profile that shows your skills and get found by employers.
welcome.employerBody: Tell us who you need and browse talent matched to you.
welcome.error: We couldn’t save your choice. Please try again.
